nodes.label: HailoRT Runtime Installer (container)
nodes.rationale: Pulls prebuilt hailort 4.21.0 tarballs and cp311 wheels from the frigate-nvr/hailort fork rather than building in-image, keeping the version locked to the same 4.21.0 the host driver installer builds.

edges.source_location: frigate-nvr/hailort v4.21.0 release tarball and wheel
both hardcode hailo_version 4.21.0; the container runtime must match the host PCIe driver and firmware the user installer builds
